# nobus_lbaas_load_balancer (Resource)

A Nobus LBaaS load balancer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nobus_lbaas_load_balancer" "example" {
  name        = "production-edge"
  flavor      = "small"
  router_id   = "ROUTER_ID"
  volume_size = 20
  tags        = ["environment=production"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `flavor` (String)
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `admin_state_up` (Boolean)
- `availability_zone` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `load_balancer_provider` (String) LBaaS backend provider sent as the API `provider` field.
- `project_id` (String)
- `router_id` (String)
- `security_group_names` (List of String)
- `tags` (List of String)
- `volume_size` (Number)
